pages.text: A $(item)Track Sensor$() beside the track (up to three blocks away, its eye facing the track) gives a redstone signal while a train is over the track beside it, moving or standing. A comparator reads how many cars the train has.$(br2)$(l)Click$() it to choose which way trains must be going: either, or only left or right as you stand behind it.

$(l)Click it with an item$() to sense only some trains:$(li)a locomotive, coach or wagon: trains with that kind of car$(li)a timetable: trains running it (a blank one: any timetable)$(li)a spawn egg: trains carrying that animal$(li)a filled bucket: tank wagons of that fluid$(li)anything else: trains carrying it$(br)Sneak-click to clear it.
Sensing trains with an electric, going right.
